result.instructions: Tools for NCBI PubMed, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Find the 10 most recent PubMed articles on GLP-1 agonists and kidney outcomes."; "Give me the abstracts for PMIDs 31978945 and 32015507 with journal and year."; "What articles are similar to PMID 31978945?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes NCBI PubMed data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run pubmed_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run pubmed_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run pubmed_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. pubmed_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: pubmed_search
tools.title: Search PubMed
tools.description: Search PubMed with the same query syntax as the PubMed search box (fields, MeSH terms, boolean operators). Returns the total hit count and a list of PMIDs; use pubmed_summary or pubmed_fetch_abstracts on the PMIDs. E-utilities: esearch.fcgi?db=pubmed.

term.description: PubMed query, e.g. asthma[MeSH] AND children[Title].

mindate.description: Earliest date in the date type below.

maxdate.description: Latest date in the date type below.

datetype.description: pdat = publication date, edat = Entrez date.

retstart.description: Offset into the results, for paging.

tools.name: pubmed_summary
tools.title: Get article summaries
tools.description: Get short metadata for up to 100 PubMed articles by PMID: title, authors, journal, publication date, DOI and PubMed Central ID. Does not return abstracts (use pubmed_fetch_abstracts). E-utilities: esummary.fcgi?db=pubmed.

tools.name: pubmed_fetch_abstracts
tools.title: Get abstracts
tools.description: Get the citation and abstract text for up to 20 PubMed articles by PMID, as plain text. Keep the PMID and journal when you cite an article. E-utilities: efetch.fcgi?db=pubmed&rettype=abstract.

tools.name: pubmed_related
tools.title: Find related articles
tools.description: List PubMed articles that are similar to one article (PubMed's 'similar articles' links), by PMID. Returns the linked PMIDs; use pubmed_summary for their details. E-utilities: elink.fcgi?dbfrom=pubmed&cmd=neighbor.

id.description: The PMID of the source article.

tools.name: pubmed_database_info
tools.title: PubMed database info
tools.description: Show PubMed's current record count, last update time and the search field codes (for example TIAB or AU) that pubmed_search accepts. E-utilities: einfo.fcgi?db=pubmed.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with NCBI PubMed
prompts.description: What you can do with NCBI PubMed here, with example requests to try.
